---
title: "wrapped fixture: Word table floats after a table"
filters:
  - wrapped
format: docx
---

Word joins two tables with nothing between them, so the first two wrapped
table floats below each follow a block that Word writes as a table. The
third holds an image above its table, and the fourth holds images in its
table's cells. The cases after them end with a div, hold a small image
and uneven columns, hold a raw Word table, end with a block quote, or hold
images in a narrow box, one over both columns.

| A | B |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 |

| Condition | Mean |
|-----------|------|
| A         | 3.1  |
